name: wapimaji-mcp
description: MCP server for Kenya water infrastructure and drought intelligence. Tools for NDMA drought phase classifications across all 47 counties, water stress data, and SMS-based alert dispatch via Africa's Talking.

tools.name: get_drought_status
tools.description: Get current NDMA drought phase for a Kenya county (Phase 1=Minimal to 5=Famine). Returns population affected, risk level, and recommended interventions.

tools.name: get_drought_alerts
tools.description: Get all Kenya counties at or above a drought phase threshold. Use to identify counties needing humanitarian response.

tools.name: sms_drought_alert
tools.description: Send drought alert SMS to a recipient list via Africa's Talking. For NGO field teams, government officials, and community leaders.

relatedServers.name: civic-agent-kit
relatedServers.description: Kenya civic data MCP (budget, parliament, SACCO, rights)

envVars.name: AT_USERNAME
envVars.description: Africa's Talking username. Use 'sandbox' for testing.

envVars.name: AT_API_KEY
envVars.description: Africa's Talking API key for SMS alerts
